title: raw_buf UTF-8 partial-chunk buffering is the correct algorithm
description: The raw_buf approach in SseStreamState correctly handles multi-byte UTF-8 codepoints split across adjacent HTTP chunks. valid_up_to from Utf8Error gives the exact byte boundary, drain(..valid_up_to) advances the buffer without copying the remainder, and the valid prefix is decoded without allocation overhead. The algorithm is sound except for the missing raw_buf size cap (JMAP-sev.1).
